objective: Explain the repeated CUT finite-ring/HNF infeasibility by extracting a parameterized necessary obstruction that depends on stable prefix/Picard invariants rather than one bounded block, and prove an exact scope adapter before any broader pruning claim.

why_distinct.cut: CUT continues bounded direct infeasibility wave execution. CERT-LIFT treats audited CUT outputs as read-only data and searches for a symbolic family-level explanation.
why_distinct.ex5: EX5 owns terminal-to-Picard64 interface production/refinement. CERT-LIFT does not construct or repair that interface.
why_distinct.178: 178 owns FULL178 numerical/prefix/transport and current-survivor witness production. CERT-LIFT does not duplicate those cuts or witness search.
why_distinct.mb: MB owns the independent multibranch final-chain geometry. CERT-LIFT does not duplicate its carrier classification.
why_distinct.main: MAIN remains the only authority/integration surface. CERT-LIFT grants itself zero MAIN credit.

inputs.initial_observation: 161929 of 172890 audited-wave candidate terminals are excluded; recent CUT197/CUT198 waves exclude 28250/28815 and 28024/28815 respectively.

route.title: Certificate signature extraction
route.goal: Extract only compact deterministic signatures from audited closed blocks: finite ring/modulus, rank/row dependency, HNF-parent route, relevant prefix residues, and exact residual/nonclosed controls. No new heavy solve.

route.title: Invariant compression and counterexample split
route.goal: Find the smallest invariant tuple that separates a large closed population from residual controls. Every proposed rule must be falsified against all available nonclosed blocks before promotion.

route.title: Symbolic obstruction candidate
route.goal: Replace empirical classification with an exact implication of the form hypotheses(d,e,prefix invariants,Picard data) => completion image empty, with explicit quantifiers and no solver-timeout semantics.

route.title: Cross-wave and first non-e8 challenge
route.goal: Replay the exact lemma on all CUT193..CUT198 source populations, then challenge it on the retained e10 scout only through an exact semantic adapter. Failure on e10 is retained information, not a route failure.

route.title: Population lift and MAIN handoff
route.goal: If and only if CERTLIFT-03/04 are exact, compute the maximal current-MAIN population satisfying the hypotheses, prove disjoint/current-authority accounting, freeze for hostile audit, and hand to MAIN with zero automatic credit.

success_levels.L1: One exact invariant that explains a positive fraction of audited closed blocks and rejects no audited residual control.
success_levels.L2: One exact symbolic lemma replayed across at least two disjoint CUT waves.
success_levels.L3: Exact scope extension beyond the original bounded e8 waves, with a population-preserving adapter and hostile audit.
success_levels.L4: Current-MAIN consumable pruning candidate after separate composition/audit.
